name: Moz Local
description: The Moz Local connector lets you manage your local SEO presence without leaving Claude. Create and organize business locations, keep them grouped by account, and publish accurate listings across the networks Moz Local syncs to. Beyond setup, it surfaces the health of each listing — flagging field-level discrepancies and network sync status — and pulls performance data including Google Business Profile impressions and leads, Local Grid rank maps, and keyword ranking history over time. Whether you manage one storefront or thousands of locations across multiple brands, you can audit accuracy, diagnose visibility gaps, and report on local search performance through natural conversation. Write actions such as creating, updating, closing, or canceling locations are clearly annotated so you always know when an action changes your live data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Moz Local to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Moz Local to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.moz.com/mcp/v1/local. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Moz Local MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Moz Local lists 32 MCP tools, including LocalAccountCreate, LocalAccountList, LocalAccountLookup, LocalGroupCreate, LocalGroupFilterAccount, LocalGroupList, LocalGroupLocationAdd, LocalGroupLocationList, LocalGroupLocationRemove, LocalGroupLookup, LocalLocationCancel, and LocalLocationCategoryList.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Moz Local?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Moz Local in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does Moz Local MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Moz Local requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Moz Local is developed by Moz. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
